retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast studio portrait featuring a central subject covered in expressive, hand-drawn white and black marker script that functions as both clothing and graphic texture.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered portrait of a subject with short dark hair, set against a stark white background. The composition is defined by the layering of thick, gestural hand-lettered words in white and black ink that wrap around the subject's body and face, creating a raw, personal, and defiant aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Text as a physical layer over the subject's skin
High-contrast interplay between warm skin tones and pure white background
Aggressive, gestural brushstrokes contrasting with soft facial features
Central vertical alignment of the subject framed by dynamic diagonal text
coreInvariants: Warm, saturated skin tones with deep shadows
Text used to censor or highlight specific body areas

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium-close-up shot from the waist up, filling the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's direct gaze and dark-toned lips at the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, follow the large diagonal script down the arms, and settle on the horizontal blacked-out text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-key white space surrounds the subject, pushing all focus to the figure and the lettering.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber and bronze skin tones
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white background and white marker ink
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep burgundy/black for lips and specific text blocks
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the background and subject; high saturation in the skin tones.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to white, black, and natural skin tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Expressive, fast-paced cursive and block-lettering script.
letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke weights suggesting a felt-tip marker
characterSpecificRedesigns: Large, sweeping 'L' and 'V' shapes that span across limbs
Horizontal black marker 'strike-through' effect used as a background for specific words
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mix of large-scale cursive script with smaller, more frantic block capitals.

candidateDirections.reason: To mimic the raw, immediate feel of the original lettering
To capture the urban, defiant tone

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast studio portrait of a person with short dark hair and dark lips against a pure white background, lit with warm, directional light to emphasize body contours.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-drawn marker-style lettering in white and black across the subject's skin, using varying angles and sizes to create a textured, 'scrawled' effect.

verificationChecks: Is the text integrated with the body's form?
Is the background pure white without shadows?
Does the lettering look hand-drawn rather than typed?
Is the contrast between the skin and the white ink sharp?

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic marker stroke pressure
Ensure text doesn't look like a flat sticker
Verify the subject's eyes are a clear focal point
Confirm the white background is completely blown out
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast portrait + pure white background + hand-scrawled marker overlay = Urban Editorial Aesthetic
